thread:
Priya: SEV2 - multiple customers reporting 5xx + huge latency after 'darkwave' canary rollout in hosted us-east-1. Errors: 502/504 and upstream read timeouts. Started ~15:02 UTC. Tickets: #12345 (acme-inc), #12346 (flicker.ai). Sample request ids: req_0a1b2c3, req_9f8e7d6. Paging oncall. :rotating_light:
deploy-bot: deploy finished: deploy-2026-03-17-darkwave (commit: f5a2c1b). rollout slices: darkwave=10% -> 20% -> 100% over 15:00-15:02 UTC.
Marco: oncall here. grabbing logs and tracing. initial read: gateway upstream read timeouts and model worker queueing. can anyone confirm which variant got traffic?
Jason: checking gateway logs. p95 backend latency jumped from 1.2s -> 5.6s for darkwave slice. gateway logs show: 
```
[15:03:12] gateway: upstream read timeout (read timeout after 30s) req=req_0a1b2c3 route=completion/us-east-1/darkwave
[15:03:14] gateway: 502 upstream_error service=model-runner-quantized-02
```
Erica: runtime note: darkwave canary enabled the feature flag `variant_route=serve_v2_q8` + prefetch window tweak `prefetch_window_ms=40`. I suspect the quantized variant has a kernel mismatch on our new kernel path which increases decode latency under certain seq lengths.
Dinesh: I'm cutting canary traffic to 0% now via rollout API. executing: 
```
curl -X POST "https://internal.console/api/rollouts/cut" -H "Authorization: Bearer $SVC_TOKEN" -d '{"slice":"darkwave","pct":0}'
```
ops-bot: Canary update: darkwave -> 0% (initiated by Dinesh).
Marco: good. watching metrics. if 5xx drops we can mark rollback successful and notify customers. also check billing meters — I see token-meter anomalies for affected customers, possible retry storms.
Priya: customers are asking for ETA on fix and billing impact. can we confirm rollback timeframe and if they were double-billed due to retries?
Jason: within 90s of the cut p95 fell back to ~1.1s and 5xx rate dropped to baseline. sample resolved ids: req_0a1b2c3 -> succeeded after rollback.
Erica: confirmed correlation: extra retries from clients + gateway retries on 504s caused duplicate token accounting for some requests. we'll pause automated retry at gateway level for 10s window and open a billing review. short-term mitigation: disable gateway retry for model-runner-* routes. adding change now.
Marco: tracing shows a hotspot when seq_len ~1024 hitting quantized decode path on a specific kernel variant. scheduling to revert quantized variant and run targeted perf tests.
Dinesh: rollback completed and monitors green for 10m. No further customer errors reported in us-east-1.
Priya: thanks. Updated customers: acme-inc confirmed errors subsided within ~3 minutes after rollback. flicker.ai also reports degraded but improved. Opening billing impact case for duplicate token charges (billing-ticket-B-2026).
Erica: root cause hypothesis: canary routed traffic to q8 quantized binary built with kernel-path v2 which regresses for certain sequence lengths. next steps: reproduce locally with seq=512..2048, run perf tests, pin build to kernel-path v1 for darkwave until patch validated.
Jason: adding logs + traces to incident folder: s3://incidents/6182023456/darkwave-logs.tar.gz.
Priya: creating postmortem ticket INC-6182 and tagging eng-runtime + billing for follow-ups. will attach timeline and customer notes.
Marco: action items: 1) revert quantized variant build for canary (in progress), 2) perf repro harness for seq lengths, 3) billing reconciliation for retries, 4) add safer rollout gating for kernel-path changes.
Priya: closing slack thread and moving discussion to incident tracker. thanks all. :thumbsup:
